about: Guard rule R5 (scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs): the static closure of each sentinel, in modules and source bytes, may not exceed its budget. `node scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs --update` lowers a budget to ceil(measured x (100 + marginPercent) / 100) and never raises one; raising a budget is a hand edit, visible in review. Set 2026-09-27 at measured + 10%.
